title: Enable built backlog views and log view incidents over about 10 merged PRs
goal: NERV runs with workItems.views built and records whether the views held up over about 10 merged PRs
acceptance: workItems.views is "built", docs/BACKLOG.md is ignored and untracked, CI and the backlog-views workflow follow the harness docs/apply/built-views.md
The backlog-views branch publishes the ledger after the first push to main and the README links it

About 10 merged PRs after the switch are logged in F-125 with each view incident (missing or stale view, broken link, check failure, coordinator misreading) or none; this evidence closes the owner's condition for harness F-096-T06
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, endpoints or personal data in Git.
validation: The backlog-views branch exists and its docs/BACKLOG.md matches main
escalation: A ruleset or token policy that blocks publishing is a repository setting: ask the owner first
A view incident is recorded and reported; going back to committed views is the owner's call

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: switch in PR #763 plus observation over ~10 merged PRs. Closed 2026-11-26: rows 8–10 logged in F-125; all 43 merges after #776 (#777–#819) published with zero view incidents. No actual: observation spanned multiple sessions.
